files.roi_assignments.csv: 5-DPI region coordinates, cosine values, and domain assignments
files.domain_metadata.csv: domain cell counts and selected-attention totals
files.celltype_edges.csv: selected attention by sender and receiver cell state
files.attention_null.csv: domain attention and cell-type-composition-matched null summaries
files.pathway_null.csv: pathway scores and cell-type-composition-matched null summaries
files.lr_pair_null.csv.gz: ligand-receptor pair scores and matched-null summaries

spatial_map.domain_rule: upper-quartile cells connected on the physical-radius graph, with a minimum component size of 20

attention.sampling: ROI cells sampled without replacement within each cell type

lr_pairs.selection: within each displayed pathway, minimum adjusted p-value, then largest observed score, then largest fold over null
